meaning.en: Whose sugarcane bow is the mind
meaning.hi: मन रूपी गन्ने का धनुष धारण करने वाली

explanation.en: Her third emblem is a bow made of sugarcane. The name says this bow is the mind (manas).

inner.en: The mind is made of sugarcane because it always seeks sweetness. From this bow the senses fly toward their objects; in her hands that longing for sweetness is drawn toward the Divine.

story.en: Kāma, the god of desire, fights with a sugarcane bow and five flower-arrows. The Devī holds the same weapons: the power of desire, now in the hands of the Mother.
